_meta.purpose: ONE-SHOT overwrite of the §88b wrong-company delivery-% cells. The 2026-08-02 MTO backfill keyed these 602 DVL cells to the wrong company (rename map funnels both DPL-Petrochem and DTIL-Tea into DVL; the bin bar's volume identifies the right MTO row - every bar here carries DTIL's traded volume while the stored pct was DPL's / own-symbol's). dv_fill_hist.json.gz was corrected in-place (4e16d24f) but is applied fill-only, so live bins keep the baked wrong value; this ledger is the overwrite leg.
_meta.rule: cell = [old_wrong_dv, correct_dv, bar_volume]. apply_dv_overwrite (build_sf_data.py) rewrites dv to correct_dv ONLY where the bar still matches BOTH anchors: dv == old_wrong_dv (+-0.011) AND v == bar_volume (the volume of the MTO row that adjudicated the cell). Already-correct cells and anything else are left alone, so the pass is idempotent (§87e-bis: second run = 0) and can never touch a bar it did not adjudicate (e.g. a from-scratch rebuild whose 20220808 bar carries DVL's own volume 64833 with dv 51.77 correctly).
_meta.src: wrong_cells.json of the §88b full-universe sweep (stored dv contradicts the volume-matched MTO row; controls: volume identity exact, existing-dv==MTO-pct on 99.987% of 4.6M overlap cells). 601/602 values independently confirmed == the in-place ledger diff at 4e16d24f; the 20220808 cell (not in the hist ledger - 2022 dv came from the bhavcopy) re-verified against a fresh MTO_08082022.DAT fetch: bin v 23295 == DTIL row traded, pct 66.04.
_meta.superseded: 2026-08-11 §89: all 602 cells were DVL, whose 2015-2019 bars were the TEA company's (recycled-ticker chimera). dvl_dtil_surgery.json.gz replaces those bars wholesale (DPL volumes + DPL dv), so the v==vol anchor can never match again — cells emptied to retire the permanently-firing 'left alone' tripwire.
